title: PLAYER 2'S HEAVY ROUNDS STOP AN ARMOURED PILLAGER TOO
why: A heavy round (40 or more) stops the body it hits for a beat. The host judges its own rounds on the round's damage before the armour, but judged player 2's rounds on what was left after the armour soak, so player 2's Magnum into an armoured pillager never stopped him while the host's identical round did. Proven in the cloud: the host's 62 round into a heavy-rig pillager set the stop, the same 62 round from player 2 as the host takes it did not. The host now judges player 2's round on the damage as it arrived, before the soak, as it does its own. Damage dealt is unchanged.
now: Player 2's heavy rounds stop an armoured pillager for a beat, as the host's do.
